subject: POC: Stellar Commerce trial plan & risk tracker
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@stellarcommerce.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: POC success criteria & proposed timeline

Hi Alex -

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so our teams are aligned before we kick off the trial: 

1) Success criteria (proposed):
- Latency: 95th percentile < 350ms for 1k concurrent requests
- Accuracy: end-user intent classification F1 >= 0.86 on your evaluation set
- Cost: average inference cost per 1k requests <= $X (we'll finalize after sample traffic)
- Integration: SDK-based integration (server-side) with prefix caching validated

2) Evaluation plan:
- You provide a 1k-sample evaluation set (anonymized) by Fri 27 Feb
- Redwood runs 3 evaluation runs (baseline, batching=auto, batching=batched-cold)
- We deliver a short results doc and recommended config within 3 business days of receiving data

3) Timeline
- Mar 2: POC environment provisioned (dedicated pool)
- Mar 3-10: Validation + perf runs
- Mar 11: Checkpoint call to review metrics and next steps

4) Ownership
- RM / primary: Marissa Cole (me) - program lead, commercial questions
- Technical lead: Dylan Brooks - infra/runtime coordination
- Escalation & engineering: Dev Patel - bug triage and fixes

Attachments: stellar_poc_success_criteria.xlsx (seed success criteria & evaluation checklist)

Next steps: can you confirm the evaluation sample delivery date and whether procurement needs additional paperwork? If OK, I'll send a calendar invite for the Mar 11 checkpoint and provision the POC environment on Mar 2.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Mar 2026 11:48:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Pre-POC test run - found blocking issue & mitigation plan

Quick internal note before we start the official runs on Mar 3: ran a smoke test with a copy of Stellar's sample and hit a reproducible issue that will block perf validation if not mitigated: 

Issue: KV cache eviction sometimes returns stale keys under high-concurrency (observed when simulating 800-1k concurrent connections).
Impact: Can increase tail latency and produce inconsistent responses on repeated prompt sequences. Blocks meeting the 95p < 350ms criteria for certain traffic shapes.
Repro steps: included in the Jira ticket below.

Mitigation options:
1) Short-term workaround (fast): disable aggressive KV pre-eviction policy for the POC cluster (reduces throughput ~8% but stabilizes tail latency) - owner: Dylan Brooks - ETA: 4 hours to flip flag & validate.
2) Medium-term (engineering): patch eviction logic and release a hotfix - owner: Dev Patel - ETA: 3 business days (followed by cluster redeploy).
3) Escalation: if hotfix not ready by Mar 5, engage infra SRE on-call and consider extending perf window by 48 hours.

Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-6421
I'll update the poc-risk-tracker.csv with the issue (ID: RISK-12).

Dylan
Senior Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
dylan@redwoodinference.com

From: Dev Patel <dev@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Morgan <alex@stellarcommerce.com>, Procurement <procurement@stellarcommerce.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal: Pre-POC test run - found blocking issue & mitigation plan

Thanks for the heads up, Dylan.

Plan of action:
- I'll prepare the hotfix branch today (INF-6421) and target a canary redeploy by EOD Mar 3. If canary is green we'll roll to the POC pool overnight.
- For the fast workaround, I've scheduled a config flip in the POC cluster tomorrow morning at 07:00 PT to unblock the perf runs (Mar 3).
- Please upload any representative logs to the shared Drive link below so I can validate post-change behavior.

Escalation path:
- If canary fails: escalate to SRE on-call (pager: +1-555-0199) and loop in VP Engineering (sre_escalation@redwoodinference.com).
- I'll create the Jira issue and include repro artifacts (logs, heap dumps).

Shared artifacts & ticket: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cPOCShared - INF-6421

Alex - please confirm if the fast workaround and short canary window are acceptable on your side (we expect limited perf variance during the canary).

Thanks,
Dev Patel
